name: Caesars Palace
positioning: Roman-themed center-Strip resort in Las Vegas, marking its 60th anniversary in 2026, with a seven-pool complex, Qua Baths & Spa, The Colosseum and THE VILLAS
best_for: Travelers who want a center-Strip base with shows, shopping and nightlife on site
Groups wanting villa-level service with a 24-hour butler

facts.text: Caesars Palace sits center-Strip at 3570 Las Vegas Blvd South in Las Vegas.
Caesars Palace marks its 60th anniversary in 2026, celebrating six decades since 1966.
The Garden of the Gods Pool Oasis is an outdoor complex with landscaped surroundings and waterfalls.
Neptune is a heated pool for swimming year-round.
The Colosseum at Caesars Palace hosts headline performers.
The Forum Shops connect directly to Caesars Palace and can be reached from inside the resort.
The Julius Tower sits in the center of the property with easy access to the casino.
The Augustus Tower pairs a classic Caesars theme with a contemporary design.
A large marble statue of Augustus Caesar stands in the main lobby.
Gordon Ramsay Hell's Kitchen serves signature dishes inspired by the TV show.
The PetStay Program welcomes dogs with in-room mats and dishes.

highlights.text: The Garden of the Gods Pool Oasis includes seven distinct pools.
Villa guests at THE VILLAS have a 24-hour butler, in-villa dining and a dedicated pre-arrival concierge.
The Marcus Aurelius villa has an outdoor terrace with a jetted spa and firepit overlooking the Garden of the Gods Pool.
Qua Spa offers Roman-inspired rituals and personalized treatments.
Colosseum Tower rooms have a classically inspired design with pops of emerald, a nod to Cleopatra.

considerations.text: The resort spreads across more than 85 acres, so walking distances vary by tower.
The hotel does not offer an airport shuttle.
Refrigerators are available for a small daily fee on request; microwaves are not available.
